top_signals.title: Anthropic selects Accenture as first embedded evaluator to help implement Amodei's slowdown proposal

top_signals.title: Trump says U.S. to build a 'large Military presence' in Greenland as part of a security deal with it and Denmark
top_signals.summary: Greenland has maintained it is not for sale, and the European Union earlier this year united to rebuke Trump over his push to acquire the island.

top_signals.title: She pays $96 a month to live in Yellowstone National Park: 'Being here has changed my life'
top_signals.summary: Zoe De La Paz quit her corporate job in Chicago and in June moved to Yellowstone to work as a seamstress.

top_signals.title: As Japan’s sewers age, a few towns are considering a switch to septic tanks
top_signals.summary: About 15% of municipalities are positive about replacing their existing sewer systems with combined septic tanks, according to a recent survey.
